messages.subject: Shiny more than 1 paste
parts:
Hi ,

if I would like to have more than 1 paste output , how can I achieve it?

eg :

 paste("The mean of Salary is " , mean(file$Salary) , sep= "") #this line will not be printed
 paste("The mean of Age is " , mean(file$Age) , sep= "") #only this line will be printed
   
Thanks!

messages.author: 5712068fdf482d27
messages.subject: Re: Shiny more than 1 paste
parts:
can't you just paste the two paste's together? e.g.

 x <-  paste("The mean of Salary is " , mean(file$Salary) , sep= "") #this line will not be printed
 y <- paste("The mean of Age is " , mean(file$Age) , sep= "") #only this line will be printed

paste(x,y)
